summary: Required foreground image for Stability's asynchronous Replace Background and Relight endpoint. Stability extracts this subject, places it into the requested background, and relights it to match the new scene.
combines: This field belongs to the direct Stability v2beta Replace Background and Relight endpoint and is not part of the Bedrock Stable Image model request.
The multipart image accepts JPEG, PNG, or WebP. Each side must be at least 64 pixels, total pixels must be between 4,096 and 9,437,184, and aspect ratio must stay between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1.
The request must also provide background_prompt, background_reference, or both.
Supporting this field requires a separate asynchronous edit operation and result-polling path, so it remains absent pending implementation investigation.
note: Separate asynchronous Replace Background and Relight feature; not implemented in this iteration.
